title: T16: bind skill steps to registered tools in rig-service
head: codex/t16-skill-tools
body:
## What

Bind skill steps to registered tools in `rig-service`. New module `anorak.skill_tools` builds the tool and `done_when` checker registries for the `LoopRunner` that `rig-service` gives the T15 clock. Steps bind to registered tools by action names in `skill.yaml` `do` (decision #33). Unknown actions fail closed with a plain log line. Resources, pause and ask-first stay in the T07 scheduler (not bypassed).

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)

Commit `7e39954`, rebased on main:
- `pytest -q` → 377 passed, 2 skipped, 1 deselected
- `ruff check .` → All checks passed
- `ruff format --check .` → 65 files already formatted
- `mypy --strict src` → no issues in 32 files (native and `--platform win32`)
- `git diff --check` → clean

## Scope: hookup only (approved by Braden)

Decision #47. Production registry is empty today, because none of the starter skills' actions has a real implementation yet (`connectors.calendar.today`, `connectors.email.unread`, `notes.write` and others; no step-to-step data passing in `anorak.loop`). T16b follows right after and makes "daily summary" real on Braden's Mac: Outlook calendar and unread mail through the T11 connector, a short note written to the drawer.

Tests: starter-skill fixture copies (`tests/fixtures/skills/daily-summary`, `tests/fixtures/skills/file-filing`) run end to end through the real clock → scheduler → runner path with fake connectors; unknown action fails closed and logs; a `risky_steps` step still pauses for ask-first; a paused clock dispatches nothing.

Files: `src/anorak/skill_tools.py`, `src/anorak/service_cli.py`, `tests/test_skill_tools.py`, the two fixtures, `docs/skill-tools.md`, `docs/local-service.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`.
